summary: Iran's IRGC launched ballistic missiles at two US Navy destroyers and multiple bases in Jordan, retaliating for US strikes on Iranian oil tankers near Kharg and Jask islands. The US reportedly attacked Iranian tankers, prompting IRGC warnings to Kuwaiti and Bahraini tankers. Israeli security forces dismantled a Hamas-linked terror network in Jerusalem and the West Bank, arresting over 30 operatives.
key_points: IRGC claims missile strikes on US destroyers DDG-119 and DDG-53 in the Persian Gulf, citing retaliation for US attacks on Iranian oil tankers. (Source: @kianmeli1/91707)
Iranian ballistic missiles targeted US bases in Jordan, including Al-Muwaffaq and Prince Hassan, with explosions heard in Eilat. (Source: @SharghDaily/182666)
US forces struck Iranian oil tankers near Kharg and Jask islands, part of a broader campaign to sink Iranian crude carriers. (Source: @VahidOnline/78282)
IRGC warned tankers in Kuwait and Bahrain to evacuate, threatening to target them if US attacks continue. (Source: @VahidOnline/78283)
Israeli Shin Bet, police, and IDF foiled a major Hamas-affiliated terror infrastructure, arresting over 30 operatives in Jerusalem and the West Bank. (Source: @New_security8200/203698)
Explosions reported in western Galilee due to IDF strikes in Lebanon. (Source: @New_security8200/203701)
UAE President warned Netanyahu days before October 7 that Sinwar planned a major attack, but alert was not passed to defense chiefs. (Source: @lelotsenzura/94327)
UK imposed new sanctions on Iran, restricting Tehran's access to British financial system and expanding trade prohibitions. (Source: @mamlekate/104386)

sections.executive_summary: Iran's IRGC conducted coordinated ballistic missile strikes against two US Navy destroyers (DDG-119 and DDG-53) and multiple US bases in Jordan, explicitly retaliating for US attacks on Iranian oil tankers near Kharg and Jask islands. The US acknowledged striking Iranian tankers as part of a campaign to degrade Iran's oil exports, while the IRGC threatened to target tankers in Kuwait and Bahrain. Simultaneously, Israeli security forces dismantled a Hamas-linked terror network in Jerusalem and the West Bank, arresting over 30 operatives and seizing weapons intended for imminent attacks.

points: IRGC Aerospace Force launched ballistic missiles at US destroyers DDG-119 and DDG-53, both equipped with cruise missiles and Aegis combat systems, claiming significant damage; the operation used the code "Ya Haidar Kara" and was framed as retaliation for US attacks on five Iranian oil tankers. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/389990)

IRGC targeted US bases in Jordan, specifically Al-Muwaffaq and Prince Hassan air bases, which host F-35, F-16, and F-15 fighter jets and shelters; a Jordanian source reported large numbers of wounded US personnel evacuated to Ramstein Air Base in Germany. (Source: @kianmeli1/91705, @naya_foriraq/89863)

Missile launches were recorded from multiple Iranian locations including Isfahan (Natanz area), Yazd, and Zanjan provinces, with video evidence showing Khorramshahr-3 or -4 cluster-warhead missiles fired from Al-Ghadir missile base. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/6947, @mamlekate/104401, @shin_persian/9621)

IRGC Navy warned all oil tankers anchored in Kuwaiti and Bahraini ports to depart immediately, stating they would be targeted due to US use of those facilities for operations against Iranian vessels. (Source: @VahidOnline/78283)

IRGC claimed to have captured a modern US unmanned underwater vehicle in the Strait of Hormuz; US officials acknowledged a technical malfunction on an older-model unmanned submersible but denied Iranian control. (Source: @VahidOnline/78279)
Iranian official stated the Jordanian people are Muslim brothers used as human shields by US forces, urging Jordanians to expel Americans to avoid danger. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/389989)

Shin Bet, Israel Police, and IDF announced the disruption of a significant Hamas-affiliated terror infrastructure in Jerusalem and the West Bank, arresting over 30 operatives including members of the "Shabab Al-Aqsa" group linked to the 2016 Jerusalem shooting. (Source: @New_security8200/203698)

Investigations revealed the network planned shooting attacks against security forces in Al-Eizariya and a restaurant bombing in Modi'in; weapons and explosive materials were seized during raids. (Source: @New_security8200/203698)
Israeli air defense interceptions observed over Israeli territory were actually occurring in Jordan, intercepting Iranian ballistic missiles fired at US bases there. (Source: @amitsegal/64783)
A US C-130J Super Hercules (registration 668, hex 738B4C) conducted a tactical transport flight over Palestinian territory at 750 ft altitude. (Source: @redlinkleb/41708)

UAE President Mohamed bin Zayed personally warned Prime Minister Netanyahu in a 45-minute call one week before October 7 that Yahya Sinwar was planning a major operation against Israel; the warning was not relayed to Israeli defense leadership. (Source: @lelotsenzura/94327)
Israeli political parties "Fourth Quarter", "El HaDegel", and "Makom LeKulam" announced they will not contest upcoming elections; registration closes at 22:00. (Source: @yediotnews25/134827)

The dismantled terror network operated under Hamas direction across Jerusalem and the West Bank, recruiting military cells to execute attacks against Jews and security forces; five key operatives indicted for managing a terror organization, conspiracy to commit murder, and weapons offenses. (Source: @New_security8200/203698)

Two Jerusalem residents, Zvich Abu Zvich (son of the 2016 attacker) and Rashid Rishq (released in January 2025 hostage deal), established the infrastructure and recruited cells throughout the West Bank. (Source: @New_security8200/203698)
Mohammed Bakri instructed Rishq and Abu Zvich in bomb-making; Ahmed Bakri planned a restaurant attack in Modi'in where he worked. (Source: @New_security8200/203698)
Additional indictments expected against West Bank residents involved in the network, to be filed by the Judea Military Prosecutor in the coming days. (Source: @New_security8200/203698)
IDF strikes in Lebanon prompted warnings of audible explosions in the western Galilee region within the hour. (Source: @New_security8200/203701)
Artillery shelling reported in the Mays al-Jabal area along the Lebanon-Israel border. (Source: @redlinkleb/41671)
No specific operational developments in Syria or Iraq were explicitly detailed in the provided messages.

IRGC issued explicit warning to oil tankers in Kuwaiti and Bahraini ports to evacuate immediately or face targeting, linking the threat to US strikes on Iranian tankers near Kharg and Jask. (Source: @VahidOnline/78283)

UK government published new regulations tightening sanctions on Iran, further restricting Tehran's access to the British financial system, expanding trade prohibitions, and enhancing London's authority to impose shipping restrictions. (Source: @mamlekate/104386)

UAE officially responded to media reports about prior warning to Netanyahu with a standard non-comment: "The UAE does not respond to media reports or speculation regarding conversations between government leaders." (Source: @amitsegal/64778)

key_developments: IRGC fired ballistic missiles at US destroyers DDG-119 and DDG-53 in the Persian Gulf, claiming significant damage in retaliation for US strikes on Iranian tankers. (Source: @kianmeli1/91707)

Iranian missiles struck US bases Al-Muwaffaq and Prince Hassan in Jordan, targeting F-35/F-16/F-15 shelters; Jordanian source reports mass US casualties evacuated to Germany. (Source: @kianmeli1/91705, @naya_foriraq/89863)
US military attacked Iranian oil tankers near Kharg and Jask islands, part of a campaign to sink Iranian crude carriers; at least one small tanker hit 4 miles off Kharg. (Source: @VahidOnline/78282)
IRGC threatened to target tankers in Kuwait and Bahrain if US attacks on Iranian vessels continue. (Source: @VahidOnline/78283)
Israeli security forces arrested over 30 Hamas-linked operatives in Jerusalem and West Bank, foiling imminent shooting and bombing attacks. (Source: @New_security8200/203698)
UAE President warned Netanyahu days before October 7 of Sinwar's planned major attack; warning not shared with Israeli defense chiefs. (Source: @lelotsenzura/94327)
UK imposed new sanctions on Iran restricting financial access and expanding trade bans. (Source: @mamlekate/104386)
sections.threat_assessment: The direct missile exchange between IRGC and US naval forces marks a dangerous escalation from proxy conflict to state-on-state kinetic engagement. Iran's demonstrated ability to strike US destroyers and bases in Jordan with ballistic missiles, coupled with US willingness to attack Iranian commercial shipping, creates a high risk of further reciprocal strikes. The IRGC's threat to target Gulf state tankers expands the conflict zone to Kuwait and Bahrain, potentially drawing them in. Israel faces a dual threat: the northern front with Hezbollah in Lebanon remains active, while the West Bank terror network dismantlement reveals persistent Hamas operational capacity despite ongoing war in Gaza. The UAE's prior warning about October 7 suggests intelligence sharing gaps persist among regional partners.
sections.regional_response: Gulf states are on high alert: Kuwait and Bahrain have been explicitly threatened by Iran, likely prompting increased security coordination with US CENTCOM. The UK's new sanctions signal European alignment with US maximum pressure, but may complicate diplomatic off-ramps. Jordan faces domestic pressure after its territory was used for US bases targeted by Iran; the Jordanian government's silence contrasts with an Iranian official's public appeal to Jordanians to expel Americans. Israel's security apparatus is operating at high tempo across multiple fronts — Gaza, Lebanon, West Bank, and now monitoring Iranian missile trajectories over Jordan. The UAE's non-committal response to the October 7 warning revelation aims to preserve bilateral ties with both Israel and the US while avoiding admission of intelligence failure.
sections.intelligence_notes: The IRGC's use of the "Ya Haidar Kara" code and public claims of hitting Aegis-equipped destroyers suggests a deliberate signaling campaign to demonstrate missile precision and deterrence credibility. Video evidence of Khorramshahr-3/4 cluster-warhead launches from Al-Ghadir base indicates deployment of advanced MRBMs with terminal maneuverability. The US unmanned underwater vehicle incident in Hormuz — whether capture or malfunction — highlights the growing role of autonomous systems in the maritime domain. The West Bank terror network's use of released prisoners (Rishq) and family lineages (Abu Zvich) underscores Hamas's recruitment resilience. The C-130J flight over Palestinian territory at low altitude may indicate special operations support or intelligence gathering. The absence of Syrian/Iraq front reporting in this dataset does not imply inactivity but reflects source focus.
